The '''Farseers''' were a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] government faction of the [[Bosph (species)|Bosph]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Bosph/Legends|Bosph]]. The faction was part of a hierarchy of Force-sensitive factions that made up all of Bosph government and ruled over the planet. Each faction would take any Bosph found to be Force sensitive, known as [[ela b'Yentarr]], at a young age and apprentice them to a member of the group, with each faction training their members in different aspects of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="AE">{{JournalCite|13|Alien Encounters (article series)}}</ref> One Farseer that survived the bombardment was a Bosph named [[Bora Boru]] who went on to take up a career as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] using his force abilities.<ref name="SotOR" /> Farseers had unlimited access to the philosophical teachings of the Bosph and were also provided with their own [[glyph]], which gave them the right to possess objects.<ref name="AE" />
